name: The Kroger Co.
moat_justification: Moderate/narrow moat: genuine scale (#2 US grocer, ~$147.6B revenue), loyalty-data and retail-media profits (Precision Marketing profit +24% in Q2 FY2026; alternative profit businesses $1.5B operating profit in fiscal 2025), high-margin Our Brands private label, and >$16B e-commerce — but the product is a commodity, switching costs are near zero, pricing power is inflation pass-through only, and Kroger is currently losing share to Walmart, Costco and Amazon (Numerator, 12m ended Jun 30 2026), with structurally thin 1-2% net margins. CAP 8.5 years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 8 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 3.4%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2026 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 5.3x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Durable #2 US grocer, narrow moat 5/10, tiny SBC and heavy buybacks — but at $60.75 the weighted IRR is 9.0% and even the super-bull case misses 15%; it only clears the hurdle near $31.
moat_for: #2 US grocer scale — ~$147.6B revenue, dense local store/pharmacy/fuel networks
Loyalty data + Kroger Precision Marketing retail media (profit +24% Q2 FY26); alternative profits $1.5B op profit FY25
Our Brands private label — high margin, 900+ new items in fiscal 2025, tailwind from value-seeking shoppers
E-commerce scale >$16B sales FY25, +20% growth, pivoting to store-based fulfillment
moat_against: Walmart structural cost/scale advantage (~23.6% share); Kroger losing share to Walmart/Costco/Amazon
Near-zero switching costs — shoppers multi-home; Aldi/Lidl discount expansion
Structurally thin 1-2% net margins — no buffer vs shrink, union labor, price investment
Food-at-home disinflation removes the inflation pass-through that flattered nominal growth
